claim.claim-text: 1. A modular active grille shutter system (10; 100; 200) comprising:

2. The modular grille shutter system of claim 1, further comprising one or more tunable retention features (29a, 29b, 29c, 29d, 29e, 29f, 29g, 29h, 29i) formed on the surface of the actuator pocket (18) that engage an outer surface of the housing (38) of the actuator (30) when connected to the actuator pocket (18), wherein the one or more tunable retention features (29a, 29b, 29c, 29d, 29e, 29f, 29g, 29h, 29i) prevent the housing (38) from rotating within the actuator pocket (18) by engaging an outer surface of the housing (38) of the actuator (30) at one or more gap locations between the actuator (30) housing (38) and a surface of the actuator pocket (18).

3. The modular grille shutter system of claim 1, wherein the housing (38) of the actuator (30) has a width that is no greater than about two millimeters greater than the width of one of the plurality of vanes (32a, 32b, 32c)
4. The modular grille shutter system of claim 1 wherein the frame (12) further comprises:

a first universal rail (14a) and a second universal rail (14c) each connected at a first end to the base end cap (14b) and at a second end to the base non-integrated end cap (14d), the first universal rail (14a) and second universal rail (14c) each form a side of the frame (12) having a longitudinal axis with a longitudinal channel (42a, 42b, 42c, 42d) extending along the longitudinal axis, wherein the longitudinal channel (42a, 42b, 42c, 42d) has a deformable edge opening (44a, 44b, 44c, 44d); and a secondary attachment (50a, 50b; 52) having at least one clip (54a, 54b, 54c) for connecting to the longitudinal channel (42a, 42b, 42c, 42d) of one of the first universal rail (14a) or the second universal rail (14c), wherein the at least one clip (54a, 54b, 54c) has at least one post (56a, 56b, 56c, 56d, 56e, 56f, 56g) larger than the deformable edge opening (44a, 44b, 44c, 44d), wherein the at least one post (56a, 56b, 56c, 56d, 56e, 56f, 56g) slides into the longitudinal channel (42a, 42b, 42c, 42d) and deforms the deformable edge opening (44a, 44b, 44c, 44d) to fix the secondary attachment (50a, 50b; 52) to the longitudinal channel (42a, 42b, 42c, 42d).
5. The modular grille shutter system of claim 4 wherein the secondary attachment (50a, 50b; 52) is an auxiliary mount (52) used to mount a secondary component.

6. The modular grille shutter system of claim 5 wherein the secondary attachment (50a, 50b; 52) is a center bar (50a, 50b) that extends across an opening of the frame (12) to provide support to the frame (12).
